verdict.rationale: Adyen documents part of this story. Its API returns `resultCode`, `refusalReason` and `refusalReasonCode` on failed payments, and webhooks push asynchronous status changes, so an agent can observe failures. Nothing in the evidence shows a payment-retry or dunning capability: idempotency keys only make a repeated API request safe, and payment links and the MCP link tools are building blocks a developer would have to assemble into outreach. missing for 10: documented automatic or agent-driven retry of failed payments, dunning workflows or customer outreach, MCP tools for querying failed payments, independent corroboration.
